review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: THE WORK: Design, implement, and maintain secure and scalable network infrastructure across enterprise environments. Monitor network traffic, troubleshoot performance issues, and enforce QoS policies. Maintain accurate documentation, topology maps, and support network upgrades and expansions. Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainabi
eligibility_evidence: WHO WE ARE: Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services.
Flexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely (most of the time), onsite at a client or in an Accenture office - depending on specific project circumstances.

WHAT WE BELIEVE: Accenture does not discriminate employment candidates on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, national origin, political beliefs, trade union membership, ethnicity, denomination, sexual orientation or any other basis impermissible under Polish law.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Be proactive in skill enhancement and enthusiastic about professional growth through hands-on experience and cross-functional collaboration.

review_candidates.title: Network engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Обязанности: • Администрировать и развивать сетевую инфраструктуру банка • Настраивать маршрутизаторы, коммутаторы и Firewall • Работать с VLAN, Routing, NAT, ACL, STP, LACP • Настраивать и сопровождать OSPF, VPN и другие сетевые технологии • Обеспечивать отказоустойчивость и резервирование сетевой инфраструктуры • Мониторить оборудование и каналы связи • Диагностировать и устранять сетевые инциденты • Участвовать в проектировании и внедрении новых сетевых решений • Взаимодействовать с провайдер
